title: TOKYO WALKING【WATANABE】/3D AUDIO
author: TOKYO WALKING 【WATANABE】
description: Hello everyone! I'm Watanabe. Welcome to my TOKYO WALKING's podcast! Through my podcast, you can experience various sounds of Japan such as TOKYO street, stations, countrysides, shopping mall, etc. Enjoy the cities of Japan with high-quality Binaural sounds!
